title: Merge slot and merge executor
description: One slot per project and base branch. After verifier concurrence and green checks the Owner approves; the slot activates; head SHA and mergeability are revalidated immediately before the effect; the merge goes through the host with an expected-head compare-and-set (or the merge queue); the grant is consumed, merged_sha recorded and the probe runs on the merged artifact. Void on head change, base drift, expiry or kill switch; one bounded rebase attempt.
acceptance: Pushing a commit after approval voids the slot and the approval, and nothing is merged (chaos test)
Two PRs queue; the second gets the slot only after the first lands and the base tip is rechecked
The merge call carries the approved head SHA as expected-head and a stale head is refused by the host
